independent_acceptance_scope.result: All six existing local correction groups are supported with their stated limits. The projection isomorphism is false but unnecessary for the numerical distribution contradiction. The Ax?Schanuel proof already draws the correct restricted diagram. The dense-orbit example challenges an incomplete general inference, not the actual cone setting. No new counterexample to the conditional principal theorems is established.
counterevidence_and_severity_basis: P1: later actual period charts and the unprojectivized foliation use the correct dimensions; the fixed-target Hurwitz immersion requires the stated translation quotient.
P2: the minimal quotient differs from the whole isotypic block, but a nonzero abelian quotient of that CM isotypic block retains the CM/isotypic property needed for the stated characterization.
P3: the inaccurate exhaustive square-tiled description does not enter the separate Q(i)-density construction.

P4: the false isomorphism can be deleted; the universal inequality dim(image)<=dim(source), weaker than the printed claim, already supplies the same strict contradiction under the existing monodromy dimension input.
P5: the new diagram immediately after the incorrect containment already uses B,L and pr restricted toL. The iteration on that actual diagram remains valid with its appropriate inverse image.

P6: cone/trivial-kernel assumptions already present complete the irreducibility inference; group-index errors leave the orbit exclusion unchanged; projectivization or the checked moving-zero monodromy supplies the stated genus-two step. No full-assumption main-theorem counterexample is claimed.
